remarks: Looking for an immaculate, updated, move-in-ready home? This is it!! Spacious, fully fenced, 3 bedroom, 2 full bath home with all of the extras. Completely updated kitchen offers beautiful hardwood soft close cabinetry, quartz countertops, a stylish glass tile backsplash and a pot-filler. Large dining area with even more cabinets and counter space. First-floor bathroom with heated ceramic floors (bathroom and hall), quartz vanity, Amish made cabinets, and a beautiful ceramic tile shower. Extra-large primary bedroom with a full bath, heated ceramic tile floor, marble vanity with double sinks, a ceramic tile shower with a bench, and an oversize soaking tub. Supersized, covered, stamped concrete, and fan-cooled patio create your backyard oasis. Patio was recently sealed. The updates don't stop. Vinyl windows, updated plumbing and electrical, and copper gutters were added to the front of the home. New dishwasher 2025, smart Ecobee thermostat, and new interior painting throughout.
